name: Heaven's Secret
source:
You died and went to… the Angels and Demons Academy? Devilish lecturers, angelic sweethearts, and the temptation to break Heaven's rules – what else awaits you in this dangerous, fantastical afterlife?

From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Heaven's_Secret]romance-club.fandom[/url]
translation:
你死后竟然来到了……天使与恶魔学院？魔鬼般的老师、天使般的心上人，以及违背天堂戒律的诱惑——在这个危险又奇幻的死后世界，还有什么在等着你？

摘自[url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Heaven's_Secret]romance-club.fandom[/url]
